Extracting the First Prime Greater than m

An explicit finite formula selects the smallest prime above a given integer using factorial congruences, greatest common divisors, and valuations.

The construction turns tests for primality into a formula that isolates the first prime beyond a prescribed integer. The point is the exact arithmetic mechanism, rather than a practical prime-search algorithm.

Background

Elementary number theory, factorials, and divisibility.
